examples.arabic: عندي اجازة يومين عايزة اروح اسوان
examples.english: I have a two-day holiday, I want to go to Aswan.
examples.transliteration: Andy agaza yomein ayza arouh Aswan.

examples.arabic: طب وإحنا عندنا طيارة أسوان النهاردة.
examples.english: But we have a flight to Aswan today.
examples.transliteration: Tab we ehna andena tayyara Aswan el naharda.

examples.arabic: لما روحت البيت اكتشفت ان خالي اصلا عايش في اسوان ومحتاجش جواكت
examples.english: When I went home, I discovered that my uncle actually lives in Aswan and doesn't need jackets.
examples.transliteration: lamma rowwaḥt il-beet iktashaft in khaali aṣlan 3aayish fi Aswan w ma-ḥtaagsh gawaakit
